acceptanceCriteria: A candidate manifest that lists only Core artifacts is accepted by the reader and installer, covered by a fixture.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-1/wave-2 pull requests (#74-#82). Review of PR #80 (V1-0007): the manifest reader and installer assume the companion set is present.

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-24 by PR #135 (merge 6d4873a52). Criterion 1: internal/releasecandidate admits a closed Core-only manifest profile corvint-core-release-candidate/0 (candidate.go:20), with each Core role bound to one path. TestPRSV1005CoreOnlyCandidateVerifiesAndInstalls verifies and installs a Core-only fixture without companion evidence. TestPRSV1005CoreOnlyCandidateRefusals covers ten refusals (internal/releasecandidate/verify_test.go). Both pass at 6d4873a. The contract is in docs/specs/public-release-v0.md:84 under PRS-V1-005. Limits: the assembler still requires companion input, so no Core-only candidate can yet be produced (follow-up ticket needed). The core-archive check still reports four platforms while PRS-V1-004 names two. Core workflow rows are forced NOT_RUN. The version token accepts alpha only. GitVersion is unchecked, and the Core-only source archive is bound by digest only. Owner-only: spec intent edits to public-release-v0.md, corvint-1.0-product-and-release-v1.md and the DCW compatibility paragraph; the receipt repin (V1-0216). Sealed at .corvint/changes/dc46f60b815359f1bc14934ce152daefa1ad12c3.cem.json. Evidence digests: sha256 at 6d4873a of the sealed CEM, candidate.go, verify_test.go, public-release-v0.md. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner focused-verification policy).

title: release: no Core-only candidate path in the combined manifest reader and installer
